g.text: REFERENCE RENDER (ISO2) — rendered off this solid,
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm AND DEGREES. EVERY DIMENSION AND
EVERY HOLE CALLOUT WAS MEASURED OFF THE SOLID.
3. THINNEST WALL, WHOLE SOLID (RAY MINIMUM): 0.7500 mm, AT
X=8.749 Y=8.021 Z=17.000 — MEASURED OVER THE WHOLE
SOLID BY RAY+EXACT AT 1.2760 mm SAMPLE SPACING (A
FEATURE NARROWER THAN THAT CAN BE MISSED). THIS IS A
DISTANCE THROUGH MATERIAL, NOT A WALL: AT AN EDGE, A
FILLET RUN-OUT OR A CHAMFER TIP IT IS REAL AND
UNPRINTABLE BY DEFINITION. DO NOT JUDGE PRINTABILITY BY
IT — THE NEXT NOTE IS THE ONE THAT DOES.
4. PRINTABLE MINIMUM WALL: 1.5170 mm, AT X=6.911 Y=6.898
Z=17.000 — MEASURED AS THE SMALLEST MEDIAN WALL OVER A
NEIGHBOURHOOD OF 3.8270 mm (>= 8 SAMPLES), RAYS CAPPED
AGAINST THE 0.8000 mm FLOOR (2 PERIMETERS @ 0.4 mm
5. DETAIL CALLOUTS (A.7): NONE. DETAIL A dropped: a Ø17.2
mm region needs 10:1 to beat the sheet's 5:1 by 2x and
only 74 mm of the bottom band is free — it would be
drawn the same size as the view it points at; DETAIL B
dropped: a Ø16.0 mm region needs 10:1 to beat the
sheet's 5:1 by 2x and only 74 mm of the bottom band is
free — it would be drawn the same size as the view it
points at. THE REGIONS ARE DRAWN AT THE SHEET SCALE
6. GENERAL TOLERANCE CANNOT DETERMINE — SEE PRINT / DFM
7. SECTION A-A AT X=0.00: THINNEST MATERIAL IN THIS PLANE
ONLY 0.79 mm, AT Y=14.45, Z=-4.10 — A SCAN OF ONE CUT,
8. FRONT VIEW: hidden lines KEPT: without them 19 of 532
edge samples have no ink within 0.35 mm (worst 4.641
mm) and the feature would be missing from the sheet.
9. TOP VIEW: hidden lines KEPT: without them 27 of 590
edge samples have no ink within 0.35 mm (worst 1.051
mm) and the feature would be missing from the sheet.
10. RIGHT VIEW: hidden lines KEPT: without them 8 of 584
edge samples have no ink within 0.35 mm (worst 0.500
mm) and the feature would be missing from the sheet.
1. ORIENTATION: laid flat (34 x 36 x 22 mm)
2. THINNEST WALL, WHOLE SOLID (RAY MINIMUM): 0.7500 mm — a
distance through material, NOT a printable wall where
it falls on an edge, a fillet run-out or a chamfer tip.
Printability is judged on the next line.
3. PRINTABLE MINIMUM WALL: 1.5170 mm (smallest median wall
mm floor (2 perimeters @ 0.4 mm nozzle): VERDICT PASS
4. 10 horizontal bore(s) bridge at the crown: ream any
bearing or press-fit bore to size
6. TOLERANCE BASIS, IN-HOUSE: CANNOT DETERMINE. Every
Bambu on this farm records tolerance_mm: null, cite "no
coupon printed and measured on this machine"
Bambu Lab's own H2D Pro spec sheet carries no
dimensional-accuracy line. DIMENSIONS HERE ARE NOMINAL
7. TOLERANCE BASIS, OUTSOURCED: JLC3DP ±0.3 mm FDM
ce-machines/farm-hubs). Apply the route's figure, not
both. The ±0.2 mm in cecad/machining.py fdm is a repo
planning constant with no vendor cite and is NOT used
here. One printed and measured coupon closes this note.
8. NO ISO 286 CLASS IS DECLARED ON ANY BORE: FDM cannot be
sized to one (H7/p6 at Ø3 is a 0.010 mm band). REAM
bearing and press-fit bores after printing.
22.500 mm BBOX, THIN/LONG 0.6269. THE FULL THIRD-ANGLE
every row measured off the solid; positions are model
coordinates, mm. C'BORE side is the face it opens on;
INT = centred in the bore, opening on neither face.
